notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Navigators, Strinova is ready for the next major game updates. here are the highlights: 

New Game Modes: Bobblehead Brawl


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938918/4418729a55b225a606b0591117d921f8a2fd028d.jpg

Duration: April 24, 07:00 – June 26, 03:59 (UTC+0)
A chaotic 5v5v5 team-based Team Deathmatch variant where Navigators are divided into 3 squads of 5.

Special Mechanics:

- Superstrings transform into bobbleheads! Deal damage, eliminate enemies, or heal allies to make your head upgrade and grow bigger, with the degree of enlargement positively correlated with the Bobblehead level (max level: 6). Larger heads grant higher score multipliers;

- Shooting teammates provides healing effects;

- During the Final Showdown, Bobblehead Kings can only use melee weapons, and respawn is disabled;

- Victory is determined by round-win rankings.


New Game Modes: Boom Fest


Duration: April 29, 07:00 – May 5, 03:59 (UTC+0)

Welcome to the exciting Boom Fest! Share the fun with your friends!

Special Mechanics:

- Random Navigators become Bomb Carriers each round;

- Bomb Carriers can pass the Bomb via melee attacks;

- Detonation occurs after a set duration or at round end, eliminating carriers;

- Earn points by surviving. The Navigator with the highest cumulative score wins;

- Weapons, throwables, and gadgets inflict Slow on Superstrings.


New Escort Map: – Tyve Oasis

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938918/61ecd4cec56ae778ea136226d849435677a99503.jpg

Tyve Oasis, located in the Seeda Peninsula's Migo River Basin, is a tourist hotspot. Generations of settlers built this town around the ancient Komos Tower. 

As part of a strategic long-term plan for Seeda Peninsula, The Scissors are deploying a hacking device deep into the heart of the oasis...

New Team Arena Map: – Wright Campus (Custom Rooms Only)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938918/cdef56373a6cd649c64fe4d9ea7cc9601f5c5eea.jpg

Located in the western corner of Elitron City, Wright Campus is the permanent venue for the Field Theory and Stringification Conference. The campus boasts beautiful surroundings and an open, scholarly atmosphere.

For more details and specific adjustment in this patch, read on: Patchnote

notes.title: Global Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Navigators, we are excited to announce...

Strinova will officially launch on Nov 21st 16:00 (PST)! It will be available here on Steam and on our website. 

It's been quite a journey, and we could not have done this without you. Over the past few months, we have been tirelessly working to make Strinova as best as it can possibly be. Your feedback and participation throughout the closed beta were invaluable, and we are even more excited for what's to come. Get hyped and get ready!

Please follow us on social media!
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/strinova

Follow us on X : https://x.com/Strinova_EN

And of course, wishlist here!
